name: Left Hand Magic
source:
A talented Battlemage, you are struggling to find work for your type of magic in a post-industrial (Magitek/Magic Punk) world that no longer has much need for battle magic. To be fair, you were warned about this. Your parents, your friends, even your instructors at university all pointed out that Battle Magic, once the most important of all fields, has long lost its purpose. The monsters are all dead or uplifted to being civilized. Dungeons all long since discovered, looted, and destroyed. Even warfare is now dominated by magitek warmachines and tools, all the products of artificers and enchanters.

But...battle magic was what you were good at, a prodigy by any measure. And you had a passion for wielding the elements in destructive ways anyway. Who doesn't want to light things of fire or fry bad guys with lightning?! You ignored them all and mastered your area of expertise, graduating from the most prestigious magical academy on the continent! Too bad that no one needs you now...

Down on your luck, skipping from menial job to menial job, you're unexpectedly recruited by Left Hand Solutions, a company that's made up of similar people, each trying to find positive uses for their particular types of magic in the modern world. Given that those include Blood Magic, Necromancy, and Summoning...you wonder if they aren't just a little bit insane. Even so, the pay is good and the staff are all friendly...and female. Maybe this won't be so bad?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=568893]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一位才华横溢的战斗法师，却在后工业时代的魔导科技／魔法朋克世界里，难以找到能发挥专长的工作。这个世界，早已不太需要战斗魔法。公平地说，大家早就提醒过你：父母、朋友，甚至大学里的老师，都指出战斗魔法虽然曾是最重要的领域，如今却早已失去用武之地。怪物不是死光了，就是已经成为文明的一员。地城早被发现、搜刮、摧毁。就连战争，如今也由魔导战争机器与工具主宰，而它们全是魔法工匠与附魔师的成果。

可…战斗魔法就是你的强项，无论从哪个标准看，你都是天才。况且，你本就热衷于以破坏性的方式驾驭元素。谁不想放把火，或用雷电劈倒坏人呢？！你无视了所有劝告，精通自己的领域，从大陆最负盛名的魔法学院毕业！可惜，如今没人需要你…

时运不济的你，在一份又一份杂活间辗转，却意外被“左手解决方案”公司招募。这里的人与你境遇相似，都在努力为各自的魔法，寻找适用于现代社会的正当用途。考虑到这些魔法包括血魔法、死灵术与召唤术…你不禁怀疑，他们是不是有点疯。不过，薪水不错，同事们也都很友善…而且全是女性。或许，这工作没那么糟？
